story.titleZh: 法拉利双车第32圈同时进站，赛道正清理阿尔本赛车
story.summaryZh: 法拉利官方发帖称，比赛第32圈（共51圈），车队两位车手同时进入维修区，此时赛道工作人员正试图清理阿尔本的赛车。
story.originalTitle: Lap 32/51: Both our boys come into the pits, as the Marshalls try to clear the car of ALB
story.summaryEn: Lap 32/51: Both our boys come into the pits, as the Marshalls try to clear the car of ALB
detailZh: “第32圈（共51圈）：我们的两位车手进入维修区，此时赛道工作人员正试图清理阿尔本的赛车。”——法拉利车队官方X账号（@Scuderia法拉利）
detailEn: Lap 32/51: Both our boys come into the pits, as the Marshalls try to clear the car of ALB
keyPointsZh: 比赛全程51圈，进站发生在第32圈
进站原因是赛道工作人员正在清理阿尔本（ALB）的赛车
keyPointsEn: The pit stops happened on lap 32 of a 51-lap race
The stops came as marshals tried to clear the car of ALB from the track
